additional_info.subject: Error Description
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Is it possible to check charger
313508370009 at 10:36:28 a.m. and at 10:42:14 a.m. (cu time) of today 7 of March?
A customer tried to charge, but she had 0 recharges. It seems that there are a lot of connection warnings.
She also tried to charger on the charger n. 170002444 between 10:57:18
and 11:00:20 a.m. (cu time) and on the charger 170002447 at 11:07:16 a.m. (cu time), but she always had 0 recharges.
Can you please check logs and say if there are problems on these 3 chargers?
Thank you
software version
: v8.0.5-0-g33a6c1d+APN

additional_info.subject: ID0482808-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/S1 313508370009] CU logs check CRM:02889001246
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support, I hope this email finds you well.
Following your request, we could check the logs and found the reason for the session don't start.
This information is from the first time stamp
2026-03-07T10:36:41.41
Following the log report in the charger, as you can see on this screenshot we have the information highlighted
On this charge session the connection didn't had the PLC link and the car was not ready for the charge session.
Checking the log for the second timestamp you shared we have the same information
The person used the same outlet, charge session didn't had the PLC link between the charger and the car, because the car shows not ready.
Is there any other information I can check for you today?
With best regard
s,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
